mechanisms.name: atomic size effect on sublattice site occupancy

evidence.section: 4.1. Atomic size effect of alloying elements on the phase and site preferences
evidence.quote: As atomic radii of alloying X elements become closer to that of Al atom, energy change parameter, ENi Al X , values decrease and more Al sublattice sites are preferentially occupied in γ′ precipitates.
with increasing aging time, mechanical strength of alloys weakens in parallel with increasing size of γ′ precipitates simultaneously evolved from near-spherical to irregular forms
